overall_assessment: All 28 packet courses were reviewed in full as presented, including every removal span. Staff names and administrative course dates each survive in nine suspect offerings, concentrated in clinical PhD courses plus a law teaching list; none of the eight random controls has these leaks, so the sample does not establish an institution-wide failure. Phone flags are false alarms from PMIDs and form/link identifiers; many name_like and removed flags reflect preserved subject terms, organisations, bibliography authors or correctly removed contact/reading-list boilerplate, but email fragments, semester-removal artifacts and unmatched reading-list boilerplate remain.

findings.description: Nine offerings retain institutional staff names. Examples include responsibility and speaker lists under Faglig ansvar/Hovedansvarlige/Innledere, English Academic responsibility and Course coordinator labels with intervening unit names, and Undervisere. CCBIONEUR911 also places staff names under Emneevaluering. These are institutional roles, not bibliography or subject-matter names. The name_like flag detects some but misses others, including the named responsible person in CCBIO906; name_label flags are absent despite the leaks.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: R/anonymize.R .anon_uib() has no clinical-course staff-block rule. Generic staff-role patterns omit Faglig ansvar, Hovedansvarlige, Innledere and Undervisere; heading matching consumes only one name line, and English compound labels with a unit between the role and the name do not match.
findings.suggested_fix: Add bounded UiB staff-section rules for Faglig ansvar, Hovedansvarlige, Innledere and Undervisere that consume all staff entries until the next known course-section heading. Handle Academic responsibility/resposibility and Course coordinator with optional unit text, initials and titles. For the clinical-course Emneevaluering layout, remove explicitly labelled staff lines and names-only lists while preserving actual evaluation prose. Add regression cases for each layout.

findings.description: Nine offerings retain administrative dates: teaching periods such as 8.-10. november 2023, 17.-19. januar 2024 and 14.-16. januar 2026, registration deadlines such as Frist 1. september 2023, and the GEOV298 application deadline 18. desember 2024. NEUROSYSM930 also retains Dato: 4.-6. desember and Frist: 1. september. The admin_date flags are real; these dates schedule course administration and are not publication, historical or government-document dates. The 2026 year in the CCBIONEUR911 registration-link label also survives.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: R/anonymize.R .anon_generic() removes numeric dates and season/year forms, but long month-name dates are principally handled after approval/update keywords. .anon_uib() only has a narrowly formatted weekday/date/room timetable rule, leaving teaching-period ranges, deadlines and dated registration-link labels.
findings.suggested_fix: Extend .anon_uib() with context-bound removal for Norwegian month-name dates and day ranges in Undervisningsperiode, dated Undervisningssemester fields, Dato lines and registration/application deadline clauses. Strip year stamps in explicitly identified course-registration link labels. Retain deadline instructions and durations, and preserve bibliography and government-document dates through existing guards; test the observed date/range forms.

findings.evidence: Emneansvarleg og administrativ kontaktperson finn du på Mitt UiB, kontakt eventuelt studierettleiar på@gfi.uib.no
findings.description: Both ENERGI322 offerings retain the address-like fragment på@gfi.uib.no after removal of concatenated generic adviser addresses. Thus the email flags identify a residual contact artifact, but the packet does not establish a surviving private-person mailbox. This is more than a harmless empty contact label: an apparent address remains in the published sentence.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: R/anonymize.R .anon_generic() applies boundary-sensitive email substitutions once, with a lazy top-level-domain match. Malformed concatenated adviser addresses are not fully normalized; a residual address-like fragment survives the contact cleanup. The packet establishes the residual fragment but does not establish its exact intermediate origin.
findings.suggested_fix: Use Unicode-aware local-part and address boundaries, explicitly handle concatenated adviser addresses, and repeat address cleanup to a fixed point for such malformed blocks. Verify that neither ENERGI322 output retains an @domain fragment while unrelated prose is preserved.

findings.description: Semester/year removal leaves ECTS)() in both GOV216 offerings (the artifact flags are real), Tema for: and a bare colon before the quantum-computing topic in INF367, and a sentence beginning er vurderingsforma endra in the random KIN102 control after Våren 2020 is deleted. The dating should be removed, but its surrounding course-content syntax should remain readable. These are local punctuation/sentence artifacts, not broad paragraph loss or evidence of removed topic titles.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: R/anonymize.R generic semester/year patterns remove dates without their enclosing parentheses or dependent introductory wording. Empty-parenthesis cleanup requires preceding whitespace and therefore misses the adjacent ECTS)() case; two-digit season/year removal also leaves a following colon.
findings.suggested_fix: Remove enclosing parentheses when their entire contents are an administrative semester label, including parentheses attached to a preceding closing bracket, without changing code calls. Normalize matched topic prefixes such as Tema for høst 2024: to Tema: and remove punctuation belonging to a deleted standalone semester heading. When a deleted semester opens a prose sentence, capitalize the surviving first word. Add regression checks for GOV216, INF367 and KIN102.

findings.evidence: Litteraturlista vil vere klar 1. august for haustsemesteret og 1. januar for vårsemesteret
findings.description: The random MOL100 control retains a reading-list publication notice without innan; INFO284 retains its English equivalent, including the spelling Decemeber. These are variants of the date-dependent UiB reading-list boilerplate explicitly targeted by the handler, not reading-list content. Neither variant is detected by the pre-pass flags. Other offerings correctly lose the standard Norwegian notice, explaining many large-removed-share flags.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: R/anonymize.R .anon_uib() requires klar/klare innan/innen in this branch and only recognizes Norwegian Litteraturlist prefixes; it misses klar immediately followed by a date and The reading list will be ready before.
findings.suggested_fix: Extend the anchored UiB publication-notice patterns to cover vil vere klar followed directly by a date and the observed English ready before date ... semester construction, allowing the observed December typo. Limit removal to the publication-notice sentence so substantive reading-list descriptions remain.
